description:
Several behaviors reported by sweep workers contradict a documented or implied contract in `crates/gf2-coding/src/`.

## Background

Reported locations: `bin/sim_runner.rs:675` (point seeds overlap when `max_frames > 1_000_000`; frame-parallel early stop depends on scheduling); `simulation.rs` (the parallel runner seeds `0xDEAD_BEEF` when `rng_seed` is `None`; checkpoint-resumed points are appended again to CSV/JSONL); `crc.rs` `CrcCode::new` (`n > 64` unchecked); `ConvolutionalEncoder::new` (`constraint_length >= 32` unchecked); `BcjrDecoder::new` (`n < m` underflows); `BlockCode::redundancy` (documents a panic that wraps in release). `@/inv/deterministic-seeded-execution` and `@/inv/campaign-resumability` apply to the runner items.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces each reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and that item is dropped with the evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each constructor validates its domain or documents the precondition under the `_unchecked` convention.
- [hard] REQ-03: Seeded runs are identical across worker counts and across a resume, covered by tests.
title: gf2-coding constructor-bound and simulation-runner defects reported by the comment sweep
